Messages.Author: Andre Beaulieu
Messages.Body:
Thaddeus Zho (eter...@wam.umd.edu) writes:
> Is stealing blood considered damage? If so, can it be prevented?
> I know it can be dodged, but could it be prevented with, say, Skin
> of Rock?

Vampires lose blood when hit in Jyhad, but the book explains it by saying
that the vampire instantly expends the blood he needs to heal the wound.
Steal blood just makes the blood dissapear, thus there is no damage, and
it cannot be prevented by fortitude cards. Also, you cannot steal more
blood than the vampire has on him/her/it and you also cannot send a
vampire in torpor using a Strike: Steal Blood card.

-Paul-Andre
